text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - Mixed. C$0.50 a tonne lower in the July on CBOT soybean calls and commercial liquidation while November was seen opening C$0.50 up on firm CBOT soyoil calls. Technical support seen in the July at C$384.10. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +0.96 Wednesday from +4.35 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3960 to the U.S. dollar, down to 81.35 yen, rose to 1.2370 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on overbought sentiments Wednesday with commercial demand seen at C$329 in the July.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on weaker CBOT corn calls. July liquidation was expected to be the feature.

The Canadian Wheat Board will issue its Pool Return Outlook world price forecast at 1400 CDT Thursday and was expected to cut feed barley values. Saudi Arabia bought one million tonnes of feed barley this week at US$142-US$148 a tonne, cost and freight.

FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls and expectations the CWB may cut its feed wheat price outlook by C$5 a tonne Thursday afternoon. UGG was expected to continue selling July-Oct spreads.
Statistics Canada issues its second seeding intentions report Friday at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT. The report is based on a survey of farmers from May 26 to June 4.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 lower on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
